snippet.title: Aslimelate gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446250/Aslimelate/
Demo is available now.

Aslimelate is a cozy puzzle game where you merge and evolve your slimes by matching three or more. With larger merges you can earn gold to buy special items from the shop to help you. Fill your slime vat to free all the slime, or go for a high score. How far can you evolve your slime?
